# E0423: changing a value while a view reads it

A view reads its source for as long as it lives. Finish with the view before changing the source.

- Rule: [`views.change-while-viewed`](../../reference/13-modes.md#views.change-while-viewed)
- Reported at: the modification: the place assigned, the argument passed `inout`, or the receiver taken by `inout self`.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0423:7
use std.view

fn main() / io {
  var xs = [1, 2, 3]
  let v = view.View.all(xs)
  print("{v.len()}")
  xs.push(4)
  print("{xs.len()}")
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.view

fn main() / io {
  var xs = [1, 2, 3]
  print("{view.View.all(xs).len()}")
  xs.push(4)
  print("{xs.len()}")
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0423_changing_a_value_while_a_view_reads_it.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0423_changing_a_value_while_a_view_reads_it.lt):

```text
── CHANGING A VALUE WHILE A VIEW READS IT ── E0423_changing_a_value_while_a_view_reads_it.lt:7:3  [E0423]

`xs` changes here while `v` reads `xs`:

  7 │   xs.push(4)
    │   ^^
  8 │   print("{xs.len()}")
  9 │ }
    │ ─ `v` reads `xs` until here

A view reads its source for as long as it lives. Finish with the view before
changing the source.

Two ways to fix it:

  1. Make the change before the view:

  5 │   xs.push(4)
    │   ++++++++++
  6 │   let v = view.View.all(xs)
    ┆
  7 │   xs.push(4)
    │   ----------

  2. End the view's scope before the change:

  5 │   { let v = view.View.all(xs)
    │   ++
  6 │   print("{v.len()}") }
    │                     ++
```
